# Bad Asset References Examples
# Demonstrates GFX001, SND001, SND002

# ERROR: EVENT-017
namespace = assets_bad

# Missing graphics file
assets_bad.0001 = {
	type = character_event
	title = assets_bad.0001.t
	desc = assets_bad.0001.desc

# This file doesn't exist
	picture = "gfx/interface/illustrations/nonexistent_image.dds"

	left_portrait = root

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = assets_bad.0001.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# Multiple missing graphics
bad_decision_missing_icon = {
# Icon file doesn't exist
	picture = "gfx/interface/icons/missing_icon.dds"

	desc = bad_decision_missing_icon_desc

	is_shown = {
		is_ruler = yes
	}

	effect = {
		add_prestige = 50
	}

	ai_check_interval = 60

	ai_will_do = {
		base = 100
	}
}

# Missing sound file
assets_bad.0002 = {
	type = character_event
	title = assets_bad.0002.t
	desc = assets_bad.0002.desc

	left_portrait = root

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
# Sound file doesn't exist
		play_music_cue = "nonexistent_sound_file"
	}

	option = {
		name = assets_bad.0002.a
		add_piety = 25
	}
}

# Invalid FMOD event path format
assets_bad.0003 = {
	type = character_event
	title = assets_bad.0003.t
	desc = assets_bad.0003.desc

	left_portrait = root

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
# Invalid FMOD path (missing event:/ prefix)
		play_music_cue = "MUSIC/invalid_format"
	}

	option = {
		name = assets_bad.0003.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# Wrong FMOD event category
assets_bad.0004 = {
	type = character_event
	title = assets_bad.0004.t
	desc = assets_bad.0004.desc

	left_portrait = root

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
# Invalid category (not MUSIC, SFX, UI, etc.)
		play_music_cue = "event:/INVALID_CATEGORY/sound"
	}

	option = {
		name = assets_bad.0004.a
		add_prestige = 50
	}
}

# Multiple asset errors combined
assets_bad.0005 = {
	type = character_event
	title = assets_bad.0005.t
	desc = assets_bad.0005.desc

# Missing graphics file
	picture = "gfx/interface/missing_background.dds"

	left_portrait = root

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
# Missing sound file
		play_music_cue = "missing_audio_file"

# Invalid FMOD format
		play_music_cue = "wrong/format/path"
	}

	option = {
		name = assets_bad.0005.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# Wrong file extension
assets_bad.0006 = {
	type = character_event
	title = assets_bad.0006.t
	desc = assets_bad.0006.desc

# .jpg not supported (should be .dds, .png, or .tga)
	picture = "gfx/interface/icons/icon.jpg"

	left_portrait = root

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = assets_bad.0006.a
		add_prestige = 50
	}
}

# Typo in path
assets_bad.0007 = {
	type = character_event
	title = assets_bad.0007.t
	desc = assets_bad.0007.desc

# Typo in path (gfx vs gx)
	picture = "gx/interface/illustrations/decision_misc.dds"

	left_portrait = root

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = assets_bad.0007.a
		add_piety = 25
	}
}

# Malformed FMOD path
assets_bad.0008 = {
	type = character_event
	title = assets_bad.0008.t
	desc = assets_bad.0008.desc

	left_portrait = root

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
# Missing colon after event
		play_music_cue = "event/MUSIC/cue"

# Extra slashes
		play_music_cue = "event:///MUSIC/cue"
	}

	option = {
		name = assets_bad.0008.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}
